source_policy: Historical conclusions require source corroboration; vendor claims are not independent efficacy evidence; no affiliate permissions are inferred.

issue_claims.core_claim: Puységur reported a May 4 1784 episode with Victor Race; Franklin-era inquiry tested Mesmer's claims but not the same incident.
issue_claims.boundary: Puységur's statements are historical testimony, not independently verified treatments or proof of magnetic fluid.

issue_claims.core_claim: Seller currently describes four listening formats and distinct Zen12 package tiers; 12-min-equivalence and brain-state results are unverified seller assertions.
issue_claims.boundary: Package tier, currency, checkout, device formats, purchase terms and partner email rights must be checked before promotion.
issue_claims.editorial_action: HOLD_MERCHANT; no earning link or published guide yet; no evergreen price/savings/countdown claims.

issue_claims.core_claim: 17.1 seconds elapsed between first fire report transmission start at 23:31:04.7 and final transmission end at 23:31:21.8; only 10.3 seconds of radio speech in two segments separated by a 6.8 second gap.
issue_claims.boundary: Elapsed 17.1 seconds is not fire ignition time, uninterrupted transmission time, or final moment of consciousness.
issue_claims.editorial_action: Consider future note clarifying 10.3s of actual speech if concise; no urgent correction to current draft.

issue_claims.core_claim: Seller lists Total Focus as 33-min/47 MB audio, with promotional efficacy and price claims that change with checkout context.
issue_claims.boundary: NIH research on hypnosis is not specific evidence for Total Focus; quoted prices and refunds require purchase-session verification, not only seller landing page.
issue_claims.editorial_action: HOLD_MERCHANT; never quote dynamic prices, unverified benefits or generic swipe email permission.

issue_claims.core_claim: Stone et al. 2002 reported 90% self-reported timing compliance vs 11% binder-open/close timing compliance for paper diaries, based on 30-minute windows (40 paper participants); 40 used electronic diaries.
issue_claims.boundary: Photosensors measure binder open/close, not exact moment of writing or subjective honesty. Not a meditation-efficacy experiment.
issue_claims.editorial_action: REVIEW_CANDIDATE: replace shorthand 'entries met window' with explicitly operationalized binder-open/close measure; candidate not approved for substitution.
